# Trait unification evidence inventory — 2026-10-05

Companion to `SPEC_2026-10-05_trait_unification.md`. Inputs are frozen at the
SHAs recorded there. Each row is a declaration, not an enabled runtime instance.
USE counts resolved non-template actor trait instances, concrete weapon projectile
instances, or weapon warhead instances. Multiple `@instances` count separately.
Only the first loaded assembly wins a duplicate Info class name; donor USE is zero.
“Source only” includes disabled/unmounted content; “mounted” does not prove a trait
condition is enabled. Maps with local overrides and archived maps are outside the
global-manifest count and require migration traversal separately.

The direct-field appendix records exact initializer expressions, not their evaluated
values: `new WDist(86)` and `new(86)` are syntactic differences, not balance changes.
ABSENT-DIRECT means absent from this class declaration; inherited fields are NOT
removed. Parent declarations are preserved in the source capture. Class/file diffs
are evidence, not semantic equivalence proofs. Same-stem groups are merge candidates;
the spec's family decisions and gates decide whether/how they combine.

Full frozen source, raw per-variant diffs, and inventory JSON are in
`TRAIT_UNIFICATION_EVIDENCE_2026_10_05.zip`.

| `Cameo:InstantHitWithFakeBulletsInfo` | `Cameo:InstantHitWithFakeBulletsInfo` | projectile | mounted | 184 | baseline | baseline; `Cameo:InstantHitWithFakeBulletsInfo`; `InstantHitWithFakeBullets` | HITSCAN. The warhead lands on the FIRST tick; the bullets you see are FAKE — purely cosmetic sprites that fly out afterwards carrying trails and contrails and cannot change the outcome. A rifle round crosses its range in milliseconds, so modelling it as a travelling projectile let fast units outrun bullets and made a burst aimed at a mover land behind it. 'InstantHit' resolves instantly but is documented \"instant, INVISIBLE\"; 'Bullet' is visible but travels. This is the pair of them. ⚠ FakeBulletNumber defaults to 0, which draws NOTHING — set it (usually to Burst) or the weapon fires invisibly. FakeBulletInaccuracy is cosmetic scatter only and uses Game.CosmeticRandom, never SharedRandom, so it cannot desync a multiplayer game. — `Cameo-mod/OpenRA.Mods.Cameo/Projectiles/InstantHitWithFakeBullets.cs:39` |
